_note: The /about/ page (scripts/build-about.js). Every `paras` list is Robert's own words from his revised narrative, set word for word: no recovery references (CLAUDE.md §4), nothing invented, nothing tidied. An empty list prints a visible 'his words go here' slot and keeps the whole page noindex and out of the sitemap. `ready` goes true only when every slot is filled and Robert has said go.
title: Robert Castan: about me and my mission
description: I’m Robert Castan. Cycling changed my life. In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and the money goes through the orgs’ own rides.

photo.alt: Robert leaning on his handlebars on a bridge in a white jersey, smiling straight at the camera.

film.alt: Eleven seconds from Robert’s first TSR on October 10, 2026: riding over in the dark under his bike light, his selfie in kit, then the group in a line along the bike lane at sunrise.

photos.alt: Robert crossing the AIDS/LifeCycle finish line in a rainbow Hills Angels jersey, one hand held up with his teammate’s.
Two riders’ hands held up together at the finish, a tattooed forearm and a blue sleeve.
The AIDS/LifeCycle banner on the finish-line barrier, hands reaching over it.
A rainbow umbrella over the crowd at the finish.

statement.line: I found a version of myself I actually liked hanging out with.

lines: I’d like to say I ride for everyone else.
I ride because it changed me.

photo.alt: Robert and Caleb with their bikes on a desert road at sunset, the sun low between them.
